verdict.rationale: Grafana's alerting engine continuously evaluates rules on a schedule and sends notifications (grafana-docs-24, grafana-gh-7), which is the closest evidence to 'recurring jobs,' but there is no documented workflow/job-scheduling engine, cron-like automation, or AI-agent-triggerable scheduled task API. Missing for 10: explicit scheduled report/job creation API, workflow automation beyond alert rules, and any AI-native interface for defining recurring tasks.
